summary: Iteration 28 — Verified the new Weekly Vehicle Walkaround feature end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter28_weekly_walkaround.py — manager CRUD on /api/weekly-walkarounds (list/create/idempotent-upsert per (user_id,vehicle_reg,week_start Monday)/week_start snaps to Monday/full editor PUT persists days,fault_reporting,mileage,signature/PDF sheet returns valid %PDF + 404 for missing); driver flow (GET /api/driver/weekly-walkaround upserts current-week sheet; POST /day writes today's column into the SAME sheet, sets driver_signature only when empty, updates mileage_finish, and creates a manager 'walkaround_defect' alert with message listing failed items); repeat driver submits stay on the same wid; auth isolation (manager token → /driver/* = 403, driver token → /weekly-walkarounds = 403, no token = 401/403). Regression: /api/walkarounds daily list still works and driver /api/driver/walkaround still records daily checks. Frontend end-to-end verified on the deployed URL: manager /maintenance → Weekly Checks tab (data-testid tab-weekly) → New Weekly Sheet (add-weekly-button) → picked AB12 CDE + John Smith + mileage_start=5000 → Create sheet: a weekly-card appeared and the editor auto-opened. In the editor, weekly-grid rendered 7 columns × 24 items (24 weekly-cell-mon + 24 weekly-cell-tue…). Clicking a cell cycles blank→green✓→red✗→blank. Marked 2 ticks + 1 cross on Mon, filled weekly-fault, set weekly-edit-mfinish=5250 (total 250 mi shown), drew signature, Save (save-weekly-edit-button) → toast 'Weekly sheet saved'. Reopened editor: values persisted (mfinish, fault, ticks, cross, signature). GET /api/weekly-walkarounds/{id}/sheet returned 200 application/pdf %PDF 286KB. Driver app at /driver logged in with access code ZS82JN → tapped driver-tile-weekly → weekly-day-mon..sun chips shown with today's chip ring-highlighted (ring-2 class) → tapped driver-start-weekly-today → checklist appeared with 24 items → marked all OK except item 5 as fail with note → odometer 5100 → SignaturePad NOT shown (correct: signature already set by manager earlier in the week) → driver-submit-weekly → toast 'Today logged — 1 defect(s)' → Weekly screen shows today's chip AMBER (defects_found) and 'Redo today's check' button. Back on manager side: same weekly-card shows AMBER on Mon, '1 DEFECT(S)' badge, '1/7 days recorded · 100 mi total' (5100-5000). Regression /maintenance → Daily Checks tab (tab-walkaround) still renders card list with 'Log Daily Check' + 'Download PDF' controls unchanged.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` on the New Weekly Sheet and Weekly Editor DialogContents (Radix a11y warning, non-blocking). Consider adding <DialogDescription> for screen-reader users.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3330 _get_or_create_weekly correctly upserts on (user_id, vehicle_reg, week_start). Verified by test_create_is_idempotent_same_week — two POSTs with the same payload return the same id, no duplicates in Mongo.
server.py:3345 create_weekly_walkaround calls week_start_of(data.week_start), which correctly snaps any ISO date to that week's Monday (test_week_start_snaps_to_monday).

server.py:3419 driver_submit_weekly_day only sets driver_signature when the sheet's signature is currently empty — matches spec 'ONE driver signature per week'; verified via UI that SignaturePad is hidden after the manager sets a signature.

server.py:3415 mileage handling: first submit sets both mileage_start and mileage_finish to the odometer; subsequent submits only update mileage_finish. That is correct only if the manager hasn't already set mileage_start. In our test the manager had set 5000 and driver submitted 5100 → mileage_start stayed 5000, mileage_finish=5100. Good.

server.py:3407 A defect is now derived from any item where ok is not True (uses `not c.get('ok', True)`). This is fine because the driver form always emits ok=true|false. But if an item is missing from the checklist payload, it won't count as a defect — as intended.
server.py:3379 weekly_walkaround_sheet uses asyncio.to_thread(build_weekly_walkaround_pdf,…), returns Content-Disposition attachment with vehicle+week in filename. PDF is well-formed 286KB in tests.

server.py:3363 update_weekly_walkaround uses `{k:v for k,v in data.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` — a client sending `days: {}` (empty dict) will overwrite existing days. Frontend never does this, but consider explicit non-empty check if you expect partial PATCH semantics.

WeeklyWalkaround.js:22 mondayOf() uses local timezone Date; backend's week_start_of() uses UTC. In practice both align because the frontend `mondayOf()` is used only to pre-fill the picker and the server always normalizes via week_start_of(). No bug seen but noted.

WeeklyWalkaround.js reuses CHECKLIST from Walkaround.js (24 items in 2 sections) and pdf_export.WALKAROUND_SECTIONS mirrors those items — keep the two lists in sync manually. Consider exposing a single source of truth (e.g. an env-shared JSON) to prevent drift between UI grid, driver flow and PDF export.
DriverApp.js:275 todayDone check is based purely on today's checklist length > 0 — since the endpoint is idempotent per day (upsert), 'Redo today's check' is safe. Good.

Radix a11y: two DialogContent warnings — 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' — for New Weekly Sheet and Weekly Editor dialogs. Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby attribute to silence and improve a11y.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (manager create/edit/persist/PDF + driver daychip/check/submit/alert + daily-check regression all verified)
